verdict.rationale: RevenueCat documents one first-party recurring job: scheduled data exports delivered to cloud storage or email on a user-controlled schedule. That is a real recurring schedule, not a one-off action, but it is limited to data exports, not arbitrary jobs or workflows. A community request for timed hooks, such as trial-expiry reminders, suggests general scheduling is not offered. Missing for 10: general-purpose scheduling of custom jobs or workflows, schedule configuration detail, agent/API-driven scheduling, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: RevenueCat delivers your apps' data to a cloud storage provider or to email on a schedule you control.
